ability.kindredspirits.swift_step.desc: Quickens your pace while your companion is close.
Slowly knits your wounds back together.
ability.kindredspirits.ember_ward.desc: Snuffs out flames that catch on you.
ability.kindredspirits.kindled_vigour.de: Your companion recovers its own health over time.
command.kindredspirits.player_only: This command has to be run by a player.
command.kindredspirits.no_companion: No companion of yours is nearby.
message.kindredspirits.charm_bound: The charm is now bound to %s
message.kindredspirits.charm_empty: This charm is not bound to a companion.
message.kindredspirits.charm_missing: The bound companion is too far away to answer.
jei.kindredspirits.kindred_charm: Use the charm on a companion you own to bind it. Use the charm in the air to call that companion to your side.
jei.kindredspirits.spirit_treat: Feed to a wild spirit to tame it, or to your companion to grant experience and raise its bond.
